conflictStrategy.name: Conflict resolution strategy
conflictStrategy.desc: Merge text only with a verified common version. Conflicts that cannot be merged safely keep both copies. Priority strategies overwrite the other side after saving a recovery copy.

realtimeSync.desc: Automatically sync changes as soon as files are modified

syncMode.name: Sync mode
syncMode.desc: Loose mode is faster when you have many files: it skips files with the same name and size that were never synced. Strict mode compares everything.

syncPolicy.name: Sync policy
syncPolicy.desc: Controls how changes are shared between this device and the cloud. Policies with "Override" or "Revert" delete files on the other side — use with care.

modal.title: Confirm sync policy
modal.twoWayDesc:
Sync rules: two-way sync

• Local-only change → update the cloud
• Cloud-only change → update the local vault
• Both local and cloud changed → use the configured conflict strategy
• One side deleted, the other unchanged → propagate the deletion
• One side deleted, the other changed → keep the changed copy and restore the deleted side
modal.sendOnlyDesc:
Sync rules: local → cloud (protect cloud-side changes)

• Local new or modified file, unless the cloud copy was independently deleted → upload to the cloud
• Cloud-only new or modified file → preserve it; do not download it
• Both local and cloud changed → skip and preserve the cloud copy
• Local deleted, cloud unchanged → delete the cloud copy
• Local deleted, cloud also changed → skip and preserve the cloud copy
• A file with sync history that was deleted in the cloud → preserve the cloud deletion; it is not restored unless you choose “Send Only: Override Changes”

Best for: local as source of truth while protecting independent cloud changes.
modal.sendOnlyOverrideChangesDesc:
Sync rules: cloud ← current local state

• Local files → create or overwrite the cloud copy
• Cloud exists, local does not → delete the cloud copy
• Same path differs on both sides → use the local copy

⚠️ May delete cloud-only content.
Use when you need the cloud to match this device exactly.
modal.receiveOnlyDesc:
Sync rules: cloud → local (protect local-side changes)

• Cloud new or modified file, unless the local copy has a deletion to protect → download to the local vault
• Local-only new or modified file → preserve it; do not upload it
• Both local and cloud changed → skip and preserve the local copy
• Cloud deleted, local unchanged → delete the local copy
• Cloud deleted, local also changed → skip and preserve the local copy
• A file with sync history that was deleted locally → preserve the local deletion; it is not restored unless you choose “Receive Only: Revert Local Changes”

Best for: cloud as source of truth while protecting independent local changes.
modal.receiveOnlyRevertLocalChangesDesc:
Sync rules: local ← current cloud state

• Cloud files → create or overwrite the local copy
• Local exists, cloud does not → delete the local copy
• Same path differs on both sides → use the cloud copy

⚠️ May delete local-only content.
Use when you need the local vault to match the cloud exactly.

chatbox.title: Chatbox

conflictResolution.prompt: Resolve every merge conflict in the context file. Analyze both sides of each <<<<<<<, =======, and >>>>>>> block. Preserve useful, non-conflicting information from both sides, merge duplicate passages by meaning, and retain the existing Markdown structure, frontmatter, internal links, and writing style. Do not invent information that is not present in the file. If the two sides contradict each other, cannot both be true, and the file does not provide enough evidence to choose one, ask me a specific question in the chat and wait for my answer; do not modify the file or invent a compromise before I respond. Continue resolving the conflicts after receiving my answer. Remove every conflict marker when finished and verify that the result is coherent and complete. Modify only this file.
